name: OneDrive Sync
author: uhansen
description: Monitor and control an external OneDrive sync backend (rclone mount or the onedrive-davfs WebDAV daemon) from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Status, reconnect, refresh, and folder controls for an rclone-backed or onedrive-davfs-backed OneDrive mount.

schema.label: Backend
schema.description: Which external OneDrive backend this plugin monitors and controls: an rclone VFS mount, or the onedrive-davfs Wasm WebDAV daemon mounted via davfs2.

schema.label: onedrive-davfs URL
schema.description: Loopback URL of the onedrive-davfs daemon, used only for a reachability probe (no credentials are ever sent).

schema.label: onedrive-davfs systemd unit
schema.description: systemd --user unit running the onedrive-davfs daemon (wasmtime serve).

schema.label: davfs2 mount systemd unit
schema.description: Optional systemd --user unit that mounts the davfs2 volume. Leave blank if you mount via /etc/fstab instead.

schema.label: onedrive-davfs state directory
schema.description: Directory containing onedrive-davfs's token.json. Only its non-secret expiry timestamp is ever read.

schema.label: Reconnect command
schema.description: Shell command run in a floating terminal to (re)authenticate onedrive-davfs, e.g. "ONEDRIVE_CLIENT_ID=... /path/to/onedrive-davfs/tools/device-code-login.sh". Required for the Reconnect action when using the wasm_davfs backend.
